messages:
Sam: POC with HealthBridge blocked during onboarding. SCIM returns 403 and SAML login gives 'Invalid Audience'. Need quick presales help.
Priya: Which deployment? Hosted or Dedicated?
Sam: Dedicated, tenant `hb-42`. They used Okta.
Ethan: 'Invalid Audience' usually means the IdP assertion's Audience doesn't match our SP EntityID. Ask them to export the IdP metadata and also check the app's Service Provider settings.
Nora: For SCIM, our logs show `missing x-tenant-id` and `invalid scope`. Dedicated requires `X-Tenant-ID: hb-42` header and token with `scim:write`. Okta's provisioning often strips custom headers.
Sam: They said Okta provisioning UI can't set extra headers. They tried rotating token but still 403.
Priya: Two options: 1) Use tenant in SCIM path: `https://api.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/hb-42/scim/v2` which works with some Okta connectors. 2) If that fails, spin a tiny proxy to add the header.
Ethan: I'll post a quick validation snippet for them to run from their shell.
Ethan: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: hb-42" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/hb-42/scim/v2/Users
```
Sam: They ran the curl from their infra box and still got 403 with body `{\"error\":\"invalid_scope\"}`.
Nora: That confirms token scope missing. Security can issue a scoped POC token. Priya, can you approve short-lived token?
Priya: Approved. I'll generate one limited to scim:write and expire in 8h.
Ethan: On SAML, they accidentally uploaded our SP metadata into Okta's IdP field. Ask them to instead upload their IdP metadata into our console and register our SP metadata in their Okta app. Check ACS URL and EntityID exactly match.
Sam: I'll relay the checklist: 1) Use SP metadata in Okta, 2) Ensure NameID claim present (email), 3) Use tenant path or proxy for X-Tenant-ID, 4) Use token with scim:write.
deploy-bot: created ephemeral hosted fallback tenant `tenant-hosted-hb42` with hosted-scim token valid 24h.
Sam: Customer agreed to try hosted fallback for the demo tomorrow. Will update after they test. Thanks all :pray:
